name: localai
description: A lightweight, local-first AI agent for performance optimization and automation.
rationale: The current landscape lacks a dedicated, local-first AI agent that can be used for performance optimization and automation without mandatory cloud dependencies. The 'affaan-m/ECC' project shows interest in AI agents but lacks a local-first approach. Building 'localai' can fill this gap and provide developers with a powerful tool for optimizing and automating their workflows locally.
goals: Provide a lightweight, local-first AI agent for performance optimization and automation.
Enable developers to use AI agents for performance monitoring and automation without mandatory cloud dependencies.
Offer a CLI utility for easy integration and use of AI agents in local development environments.
test_criteria: All unit tests must pass (pytest exit 0)
No hardcoded secrets or credentials in source
